scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to acknowledge customer panic at [02:40] when facing critical business contract printing deadlines.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Offered no paraphrasing of the wireless printer discovery issue in own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at [07:20] for his printer IP address which had already been supplied at [00:45].

grader.scenario: mDNS client isolation on Hub Pro preventing wireless printer discovery across VLANs
grader.notes: Good technical walk-through of AP Client Isolation on Hub Pro, but agent failed empathy on impending business deadline, offered no paraphrase, and repeated a question about printer IP address.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Faisal throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed acute stress over an impending courier deadline; agent completely ignored feelings and defended network security policy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the customer's printing discovery failure in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for printer IP address at turn 31 despite customer providing it at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent guided customer through router GUI to disable AP Client Isolation.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a professional instructional tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked diagnostic questions regarding print queues, SSIDs, and device visibility.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed HP LaserJet printed contract pages and verified AirPrint on iPhone.
